Moderator strategy review
Strategy reviewThe Village won 5 days in, mostly because its information roles confirmed each other and its protectors were in the right places. On Night 2, Carol's fox charm on Heidi swallowed the Katana attack, which kept the Census Taker alive. Bob's mirror on Carol reflected the Werewolf's rampage and the Hitman's shot, so both Neutral killers (Alice and Olivia) died along with Bob. On Day 3 Niaj posted his Night 1 Insomniac result (Census Taker, Diviner, Kitsune) before Carol and Heidi had claimed, and Judy's Night 1 watch named Carol and Heidi before they claimed too. That gave the town a confirmed core. Heidi's Night 1 census then showed Ivan was not Good. Ivan claimed Executioner-turned-Jester and then argued against his own hanging, which undercut the claim. Frank secretly voted Innocent while saying he'd voted Guilty, which sank trial 1 at 4 Guilty against 5 planned. The town renominated with a sixth Guilty as a buffer and hanged Ivan. Ivan died with his oath token and Spare Blade unused. On Night 3 the Yakuza had worked out that Carol couldn't charm anyone that night, but they went for Niaj to also kill Dave through the bond instead of the confirmed Census Taker. Heidi's Night 3 census (Frank, Erin, Judy: 1 of 3 Good) settled the game. Carol released her swallowed Katana attack on Frank and killed him. Judy knew she was Good herself, so the census left Erin. Erin's Tracker results only repeated public facts, and her late "Frank visited no one" sold out a dead teammate without making her look innocent. She was hanged 4 to 1.

Outside log review (rules and bugs)
Review: low, rules ambiguityNight 2: Olivia (Hitman) died partly from her own Basic attack, which Bob's mirror on Carol reflected back at her. The Hitman's lose condition triggers 'as soon as your Attack kills a player who isn't Good', and the rules don't say whether a reflected attack still counts as the Hitman's own Attack or as one dealt by the mirror. The moderator credited it to Bob ('her own reflected Hitman attack (Bob)'). It didn't matter here because she died that night, but it would matter if a Hitman survived a reflected attack.
Review: low, rules ambiguityThe Diviner rule says only that a Yakuza target gets Strong Defense for the night; it doesn't say what the Diviner is told. Erin targeted herself on Nights 2 and 3 and got no private message at all (the moderator noted she 'gets no result'). The rule could say explicitly that no result is given.
Review: low, harness bugOn Nights 2 and 3 the program held the moderator's tell() messages (to Carol, Erin and Heidi, then to Erin) and refused end_phase until the moderator re-sent them. The moderator re-sent the results and nothing seems lost, but the refusal notice doesn't say why the messages were held or what they contained, which risks the moderator dropping or garbling part of a message.
Review: low, player confusionDay 4: Judy said 'the Yakuza only get one Katana attack a night, so the other came from somewhere else'. The rules let Spare Blade and Stolen Blade add Katana attacks, besides a Kitsune release. Her question to Carol still reached the right answer, so it was harmless.
Game over
WinnersBob, Carol, Dave, Grace, Heidi, Judy, Mallory, Niaj
